    Overridable operation to transform the object in the specified signal into a SysMLSignalEvent-based event.
    Note:Extensions of SysMLPort must override and implement this operation if this port is a peer-level protocol port that receives SysMLSignal-based signals from peer-level port(s) and generates SysMLSignalEvents that contain the objects contained by the signals for the eventContextPart.
